description: This file defines the interface 'MethodResolver' used within the substitution engine to invoke methods dynamically on objects or strings, primarily for handling method support checks, argument counts, and method execution.

classes.name: MethodResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving and executing methods dynamically within the substitution engine, including support checks, argument count retrieval, and method invocation.

methods.name: supportsMethod
methods.description: Checks if the resolver supports a specific method for a given target class.

methods.name: getArgCount
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments expected for a given method.

methods.name: executeMethod (String target, String method, ArrayList<String> args, Substitution src)
methods.description: Executes the specified method on a String target with optional arguments.

methods.name: executeMethod (Object target, String method, ArrayList<String> args, Substitution src)
methods.description: Executes the specified method on an Object target with optional arguments.
